answers.explanation: The desktop metaphor turns directories into folders.
Xerox PARC built the first desktop-metaphor GUI; Apple popularized it.
Aqua is the GUI. Cocoa is a programming environment, which Part 7 covers.
CDE, KDE, and GNOME are all optional desktop environments for UNIX-like systems.
Taps, swipes, and pinches replace the mouse.
The keyboard is drawn on the screen. Voice input is another option.
Both interfaces sit on top of the same system calls. Only the way you ask changes.
Speed and scripting. A shell script is a batch interface built from CLI commands.
